category_edits.rationale: Normalize the shared item embeddings on every history and target lookup, keeping padding exactly zero. This tests whether embedding direction improves discrimination without item magnitude. Width, GRU topology, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer stay fixed. Checkpoint shapes remain unchanged; the generated predictor dynamically imports the updated model class.

response.change_summary: Apply unit L2 normalization to all shared item embedding lookups across all four category models, preserving zero padding and predictor/checkpoint compatibility.
